### From `packages/core/src/run.ts`

#### <a id="core-allowedoperations"></a>`AllowedOperations`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/run.ts`

The operations a run can narrow while it runs.

```ts
type AllowedOperations = {
  cancel: boolean;
  pause: boolean;
  background: boolean;
};
```

#### <a id="core-display"></a>`Display`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/run.ts`

How a run looks in the chat once it is done. `card`: its renderer stays, live. `message`: its result is shown as
a message. `hidden`: it disappears; the run is still in the tree.

```ts
type Display = "message" | "card" | "hidden";
```

#### <a id="core-invalidinput"></a>`InvalidInput`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/run.ts`

A run's input was refused before (or by) its fn. This is retryable and often expected from a model: the hub feeds the
problems back to the agent and the chat shows the run softly as "Retried". A real failure is `failed`.

```ts
type InvalidInput = {
  source: "schema" | "result" | "json" | "unavailable" | "validation";
  problems: {
    path: string;
    message: string;
  }[];
  raw?: string | undefined;
  blocked?: {
    code: "paused" | "system-needs-config" | "system-disconnected" | "system-removed" | "kind-missing" | "kind-system-disconnected" | "dep-unavailable" | "disabled" | "held" | "role-unset" | "no-such-fn" | "not-a-name" | "other-system" | "not-for-model" | "connect-account";
    reason: string;
    system?: SystemName | undefined;
  } | undefined;
};
```

#### <a id="core-outcomewire"></a>`OutcomeWire`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/run.ts`

How a run ended, on the wire. The SDK's `Outcome<T>` is the typed form of this.

```ts
type OutcomeWire = {
  status: "done";
  result: z.core.util.JSONType;
  undo?: z.core.util.JSONType | undefined;
  cost?: number | undefined;
  expose?: {
    fn: `${string}/${string}`;
    detail: "listed" | "signature" | "full";
  }[] | undefined;
} | {
  status: "invalid-input";
  invalid: {
    source: "schema" | "result" | "json" | "unavailable" | "validation";
    problems: {
      path: string;
      message: string;
    }[];
    raw?: string | undefined;
    blocked?: {
      code: "paused" | "system-needs-config" | "system-disconnected" | "system-removed" | "kind-missing" | "kind-system-disconnected" | "dep-unavailable" | "disabled" | "held" | "role-unset" | "no-such-fn" | "not-a-name" | "other-system" | "not-for-model" | "connect-account";
      reason: string;
      system?: SystemName | undefined;
    } | undefined;
  };
  undo?: z.core.util.JSONType | undefined;
  cost?: number | undefined;
} | {
  status: "paused";
  resume: z.core.util.JSONType;
  cost?: number | undefined;
} | {
  status: "failed";
  error: {
    class: "retry" | "caller" | "fatal";
    message: string;
    code?: string | undefined;
    data?: z.core.util.JSONType | undefined;
  };
  undo?: z.core.util.JSONType | undefined;
  cost?: number | undefined;
} | {
  status: "cancelled";
  partial?: z.core.util.JSONType | undefined;
  undo?: z.core.util.JSONType | undefined;
  cost?: number | undefined;
  error?: {
    class: "retry" | "caller" | "fatal";
    message: string;
    code?: string | undefined;
    data?: z.core.util.JSONType | undefined;
  } | undefined;
};
```

#### <a id="core-progressdecl"></a>`ProgressDecl`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/run.ts`

How a fn reports progress: not at all, as a fraction, or as named steps (each mapped to its title).

```ts
type ProgressDecl = {
  type: "none";
} | {
  type: "linear";
} | {
  type: "steps";
  steps: Record<string, string>;
};
```

#### <a id="core-runinfo"></a>`RunInfo`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/run.ts`

Facts about one run: what it is, who it is for, when, and where it came from.

```ts
type RunInfo = {
  id: string;
  fn: `${string}/${string}`;
  turn: string;
  user: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    email: string;
    role: "admin" | "member";
    groups: {
      id: string;
      name: string;
    }[];
    timeZone: string;
    locale: string;
  };
  time: {
    now: number;
    timeZone: string;
    local: string;
  };
  system: {
    name: string;
    instance: InstanceName;
    boot: string;
    from?: {
      system: string;
      fn: `${string}/${string}`;
      run: string;
    } | undefined;
  };
  caller: string;
  attempt: number;
  priority: "background" | "urgent" | "interactive" | "normal";
  parent?: string | undefined;
  session?: string | undefined;
  watched?: boolean | undefined;
  inChat?: boolean | undefined;
};
```

#### <a id="core-runsettled"></a>`RunSettled`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/run.ts`

How a child call ended, as its caller hears it.

```ts
type RunSettled = {
  status: "done";
  result: z.core.util.JSONType;
} | {
  status: "failed";
  error: {
    class: "retry" | "caller" | "fatal";
    message: string;
    code?: string | undefined;
    data?: z.core.util.JSONType | undefined;
  };
} | {
  status: "cancelled";
  error?: {
    class: "retry" | "caller" | "fatal";
    message: string;
    code?: string | undefined;
    data?: z.core.util.JSONType | undefined;
  } | undefined;
} | {
  status: "background";
  run: string;
};
```

#### <a id="core-runupdate"></a>`RunUpdate`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/run.ts`

A live change to a run.

```ts
type RunUpdate = {
  type: "status";
  status: "awaiting-approval" | "queued" | "running" | "waiting" | "paused" | "done" | "invalid-input" | "failed" | "cancelled" | "undone";
  text?: {
    phase: "done" | "failed" | "active" | "retry";
    one: string;
    many: string;
  } | undefined;
} | {
  type: "progress";
  progress: {
    fraction: number;
    message?: string | undefined;
  } | {
    steps: Record<string, {
      status: "done" | "failed" | "active" | "skipped" | "pending";
      detail?: string | undefined;
    }>;
  };
} | {
  type: "allowed";
  operations: {
    cancel: boolean;
    pause: boolean;
    background: boolean;
  };
} | {
  type: "cost";
  cost: number;
  total: number;
} | {
  type: "background";
};
```
